needs.proposedSignature: StaticEffect `{ kind: 'ability-cost-adjust'; amount: number; who: 'you' | 'opponent' | 'any'; abilityKind?: 'activated' | 'loyalty'; keyword?: string; filter?: Filter }` - reduce (or raise) the mana cost of ACTIVATING an ability, matched by the ability's keyword name and/or the source permanent's filter.
needs.semantics: Silver-Fur Master's 'Ninjutsu abilities you activate cost {1} less to activate.' The existing `cost-adjust` static reduces the cost of CASTING spells matching a Filter (CR 601.2f); nothing touches the cost of activating an ability (CR 602.2b). Needs the ninjutsu family too, so the keyword the reduction names exists.
needs.clause: Ninjutsu abilities you activate cost {1} less to activate.

needs.proposedSignature: CardDef field `ninjutsu?: { cost: ManaCost; commander?: boolean }` + a new `covers[].by: 'ninjutsu'` whose anchored line shape is `^(commander )?ninjutsu (\{.+\})$` and whose matched VALUE is `ninjutsu.cost.raw` (plus `commander === true` for the 'Commander ninjutsu' wording); a `KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS.ninjutsu` entry in src/cards/render.ts reading "{cost}, return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: put ~ onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking"; engine side a LEGAL_PROVIDER offering `{ type: 'ninjutsu', card }` from the HAND (or the command zone when `commander`) during the declare-blockers step while the player controls an unblocked attacking creature, paying `cost.mana` plus returning that creature to hand, then putting the card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking the same defender. Also needs `Filter.unblocked?: boolean` so the cost can be stated at all.
needs.semantics: Ninjutsu is an activated ability that functions only while the card is in its owner's hand (CR 702.49b) and whose effect puts that card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking without it having been declared as an attacker. Nothing in the format expresses any of its three halves: an ability gated to the hand (ActivatedAbility carries only `fromGraveyard`), an 'unblocked attacker' cost subject (Filter has `attacking` but no `unblocked`), or an effect that puts the source onto the battlefield attacking (`move` has `tapped` but no `attacking`). Verified empirically: a replace-mode script that claims every line of Ingenious Infiltrator still scores round trip 0.00 on 'Ninjutsu {U}{B}' with rendererGaps ['keyword:ninjutsu'], so the KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS entry is required in addition to any behaviour.
needs.cr: 702.49a-c (ninjutsu), 702.49d + 903 (commander ninjutsu), 509.1h (unblocked), 506.4/508.1 (attacking without being declared an attacker)
needs.clause: Ninjutsu {U}{B} ({U}{B}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.)
